_comment: Vault Documents — CBI/RBI pathways linked to portfolio properties. Verified via public sources Sep 2026 where applicable. Talent / performer engagements now live in Give.json (kind: talent).

documents.title: UAE Golden Residency — Property Investor
documents.minimumInvestment: AED 2,000,000 (~USD 545,000) in UAE real estate (aggregate titles OK; mortgaged / off-plan accepted under 2026 rules)
documents.notes: Don-Pierre UAE / Dubai Penthouse can support the property investor route if aggregate DLD valuation meets AED 2M. Shorter property-investor visas may also apply below the Golden Visa threshold. (Pierre Duplex is no longer a tracked holding.)

documents.title: Bahamas Economic Permanent Residence
documents.minimumInvestment: USD 1,000,000 in Bahamian real estate or Central Bank zero-coupon bonds; hold 10 years (raised from USD 750k effective 1 Jan 2025)
documents.notes: Indefinite residence, not citizenship. Bahamas Island (Eleuthera) is the linked holding. Does not itself authorize employment.

documents.title: Brazil Residence — Real Estate Investor
documents.program: RN CNIg 36/2018 (as amended) — autorização de residência por investimento imobiliário
documents.minimumInvestment: BRL 1,000,000 urban property (BRL 700,000 in North/Northeast); built or under construction; funds from abroad
documents.notes: Initial residence typically 4 years, then convertible to indefinite if investment maintained. Matches existing Brazil Estate feature notes.

documents.title: Thailand LTR Visa — Wealthy Global Citizen
documents.program: Long-Term Resident (LTR) Visa — BOI Por. 3/2568 (2025 reforms)
documents.minimumInvestment: USD 1M global assets + USD 500,000 invested in Thailand (bonds, Thai company equity, and/or Thai property) before application
documents.notes: Thailand Estate (Phuket / Thalang) can count toward the in-country USD 500k investment when titled in the applicant's name (condo freehold or qualifying long lease). Not Thailand Privilege membership.

documents.title: Monaco Residence Permit
documents.program: Carte de séjour (residence) — property + bank deposit practice
documents.minimumInvestment: Proof of Monaco housing (owned or leased) plus substantial bank deposit (commonly cited ~€500,000) and clean records — confirm live Banque de Monaco / immigration practice
documents.notes: Not a formal golden-visa statute like Caribbean CBI. Monaco Penthouse supports the housing requirement; residence ≠ automatic citizenship.

documents.title: Portugal Golden Visa (ARI)
documents.minimumInvestment: Non-property routes only (e.g. €500k qualifying fund, research, culture, job creation). Real estate removed by Law 56/2023 (Oct 2023).
documents.notes: Portugal Estate does not unlock ARI for new applicants via purchase. Fund / culture / employment routes remain; citizenship path exists after long-term residence (rules tightened 2026).

documents.title: Italy Investor Visa
documents.minimumInvestment: From €250,000 innovative startup / €500,000 Italian company / €1M philanthropic / €2M government bonds
documents.notes: Italy (Laglio) does not itself qualify. Investor Visa requires pre-approved capital into company, startup, bonds, or donation — not real estate. No Italy property is currently tracked in the estates portfolio.

documents.title: Spain Golden Visa
documents.notes: Organic Law 1/2025 ended new Golden Visa applications from 3 Apr 2025. Existing holders keep transitional rights. Alternatives: Non-Lucrative Visa, digital nomad, remaining financial-asset investor routes (non-property).

documents.title: Latvia Investor Residence
documents.program: Temporary residence via investment (Immigration Law reform)
documents.minimumInvestment: Company share capital (~€50k + state payment) remains; €150k state fund route legislated but not yet operational per OCMA
documents.notes: Latvia Towers no longer unlock residence via €250k real estate. Property and bank-deposit routes closed under the new Immigration Law. No Latvia property is currently tracked in the estates portfolio.

documents.title: Peru Investor Residence
documents.minimumInvestment: Documented lawful investment via single international bank transfer at the statutory minimum (confirm live Migraciones threshold)
documents.notes: Peru Estate supports presence but the inversionista category is business/capital based, not a property golden visa.

documents.title: South Africa Financially Independent PR
documents.program: Immigration Act s.27(f) — financially independent permanent residence
documents.minimumInvestment: ~ZAR 12,000,000 certified net worth + approval fee (~ZAR 120,000); local work prohibited
documents.notes: Cape Town / Sandton holdings may count toward global net worth evidence but do not create a property-for-visa program.

documents.title: DRC — No CBI / Golden Visa
documents.notes: Congo Cathedral — no citizenship- or residency-by-investment programme identified.

documents.title: Citizenship by Investment — Portfolio Gap
documents.program: Caribbean / other CBI jurisdictions (e.g. St. Kitts & Nevis, Dominica, Grenada, Antigua, St. Lucia, Vanuatu, Türkiye)
documents.statusLabel: No CBI from current property footprint
documents.minimumInvestment: Jurisdiction-specific donation or real-estate thresholds (typically USD 200k–800k+)
documents.notes: Current estates do not sit in a classic CBI country. Add a Caribbean / Türkiye holding if direct citizenship-by-investment is desired; existing UAE/Bahamas/Brazil/Thailand pathways are residency, not immediate citizenship.
